cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, just told the LORD that ever since he went to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, Pharaoh has brought trouble on the people (Exodus 5:23). The LORD answered that now Moses will see what He will do to Pharaoh (Exodus 6:1), and God also tells Moses, “I am the LORD.” Friend, when God opens with His name, you put the cookie DOWN and you listen.

cards.question: God says He appeared to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, Israel's forefathers, as God Almighty. Which name of His did He NOT make known to them?

cards.text: Then God brings up the covenant He set up with those three. The deal: He would give them the land of Canaan.

cards.question: Canaan was the land where Abraham, Isaac and Jacob lived as ___.

cards.text: God says He has heard the groaning of the Israelites, the ones the Egyptians are enslaving. I'll be honest, friend, that line gets me.

cards.question: God has heard the Israelites groaning, and He says He has remembered His ___.

cards.text: So God hands Moses a message for the Israelites, and it is LOADED with “I will”. He will bring them out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver them from their bondage.

cards.question: God tells the Israelites He will redeem them. How does He say He'll do it?

answers.text: With an outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment
With a ransom of silver and gold paid to Egypt
With a covenant of peace and gifts for Pharaoh

cards.text: And God isn't just getting them out of Egypt. He says, “I will take you as My own people…”

cards.question: God says He'll take the Israelites as His own people. What does He say He will be to them?
True or false: God says He'll bring the Israelites into the land He swore to give Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and give it to them as a possession.

cards.text: Moses carries every one of those “I will” promises straight to the Israelites. Friend, if somebody had brought me news like that back in the junk drawer, I'd have hopped so high I DENTED the drawer above me.

cards.question: True or false: The Israelites listen to Moses.
Promises like these, and the Israelites still don't listen to Moses. Why not?

answers.text: Their broken spirit and cruel bondage
Their love for the land of Egypt
Their trust in the gods of Egypt

cards.text: So the LORD sends Moses to Pharaoh king of Egypt with one message: let the Israelites go out of his land.

cards.question: Moses pushes back on going to Pharaoh. What's his reasoning?

answers.text: If Israel won't listen why would Pharaoh
Pharaoh is far too powerful to face
The Israelites are not ready to leave

cards.question: Moses also tells the LORD that he is unskilled in ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses and his brother Aaron. He gives them a charge about the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt: bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.

Now the story pauses for a family tree: the heads of the houses of Reuben, Israel's firstborn, then Simeon and Levi. My whole family tree is six cookie cutter kids, so friend, this is a LOT of names. Down Levi's line, Amram married his father's sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses.
After all those names, the text points right back at them: it was this Aaron and Moses the LORD told to bring the Israelites out of Egypt, and they're the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt.

cards.question: On the day the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt, He said, “I am the LORD…” What did He tell Moses to pass on to Pharaoh king of Egypt?

answers.text: Everything the LORD says to him

cards.text: But in the LORD's presence, Moses comes back with the same worry: since he's unskilled in speech, why would Pharaoh listen to him? Friend, I get it: hand me a microphone at a work party and I forget my own NAME.
The LORD answers Moses, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh…”

cards.question: The LORD has made Moses like God to Pharaoh, and Moses' brother Aaron will be Moses' ___.

cards.text: Moses is to speak all the LORD commands, and Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land. Then the LORD says He will multiply His signs and wonders in the land of Egypt.

cards.question: God says He'll multiply His signs and wonders in Egypt. What does He say He will do to Pharaoh's heart?
True or false: God says that once He multiplies His signs and wonders, Pharaoh will listen to Moses.

cards.text: Then God says He will lay His hand on Egypt and, by mighty acts of judgment, bring the divisions of His people the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.

cards.question: When God stretches out His hand against Egypt and brings the Israelites out, what will the Egyptians know?
True or false: After all that back and forth, Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded them.
When Moses and Aaron speak to Pharaoh, how old is Moses?
When Moses and Aaron speak to Pharaoh, Aaron is ___ years old.

cards.text: That's where we stop for now, friend. Keep that oven warm, because this story is NOT done.
